$comment: Anthropic + OpenAI preset (fable and astra excluded). Claude drives orchestration and design; OpenAI covers the reasoning/implementation/vision/cost lanes (oracle, explorer, librarian, fixer, observer). Fixer is gpt-5.6-terra medium: near-flagship code quality at the fastest per-prompt time, where high-effort models are too slow. Apply with: ./setup.sh --preset anthropic-openai. Agents not listed follow the global model.
